tools.name: Launchroom
tools.purpose: Our shared work app: to-dos, memory, product cards, agents and the six-step line.
tools.signIn: No sign-in, local
tools.limits: Must be running on this computer; the OS serves its built files, so rebuild after code changes.

tools.name: Merrivy Hydrogen Storefront (local preview)
tools.purpose: Local preview of the Hydrogen storefront (base-theme.json, 52 palettes, and per-product /products/<handle> pages) embedded inside Store (#/build), Checklist (#/checklist), and Manage (#/manage).
tools.signIn: No sign-in, local
tools.limits: Runs on localhost:3021 (proxied over HTTPS via /api/store-preview on mobile NetBird). Local previews never fire the live Meta Pixel.

tools.name: Kalodata
tools.purpose: Primary Numbers-First Reverse Engineering engine: query our 200-Keyword Q4 Bible across US TikTok Shop for rising 30d/7d revenue AND Multi-Video US Viral Density (>= 5 active viral videos across >= 3 US creators).
tools.signIn: Owner's Google login in Chrome (trial account); the course also includes Kalodata through the Luxury app
tools.limits: Always query with US headers (country: US, currency: USD, pageSize: 100) so results are 100% US TikTok Shop and never Singapore SG.

tools.name: Pipiads
tools.purpose: Cross-check a named product against TikTok and Meta ads, advertisers and destination pages.
tools.signIn: Through the Luxury desktop app (brother's course access); the link above is only the public vendor page
tools.limits: Owner only: agents can't drive Luxury's DICloak browser (LS-006), so it is never offered to agents for a step. Targeted cross-check only; never copy logins between profiles.

tools.name: Trendtrack
tools.purpose: Map competing Meta ads, shops and traffic for one product in one country.
tools.signIn: Owner signs in once in Chrome; the saved workspace link sends you to sign-in if the session ended
tools.limits: An empty search means limited visibility, not no competitors; keep existing trackers and pick the country mode deliberately.

tools.name: Luxury (DICloak browser)
tools.purpose: Course-included desktop browser that holds the Pipiads session and lists the Luxury Extras tool catalog.
tools.signIn: Through the Luxury desktop app (DICloak, course access); owner signs in again if it says the session expired
tools.limits: Owner only: agents can't drive Luxury's DICloak browser (LS-006), so it is never offered to agents for a step. Catalog listing is not proof of access to any tool in it.

tools.name: AliExpress
tools.purpose: Find the exact supplier listing, variant, price and delivery to the selling country.
tools.signIn: Browse in Chrome; the owner's open AliExpress tab has worked for image search
tools.limits: Official homepage, not a recorded working link. A site safety block means stop and record the missing source; never work around it, and a thumbnail or welcome price is not a quote.

tools.name: CJ Dropshipping
tools.purpose: Check whether the exact item is available, with delivered cost to the country, before deep research.
tools.signIn: No account recorded; public listings open in Chrome
tools.limits: Official homepage, not a recorded working link. Owner-named sourcing route; check the exact variant and delivered cost, and do not contact or order without approval.

tools.name: Alibaba
tools.purpose: Second owner-named place to find the exact item and a supplier quote for a saved product.
tools.signIn: No account recorded; public listings open in Chrome
tools.limits: Official homepage, not a recorded working link. A listing is not a confirmed quote or delivery route; never message a supplier without owner approval.

tools.name: Shopify admin (Merrivy)
tools.purpose: Store settings, products, payments, shipping, policies, domain and notifications for ndfdtc-br.myshopify.com.
tools.signIn: Owner's Shopify account in Chrome (store owner)
tools.limits: Owner enters identity, tax and bank fields; no publishing, domain, payment or live-setting changes without approval.

tools.name: Shopify Hydrogen / Oxygen
tools.purpose: See storefront deployments and environments that host the custom Merrivy site.
tools.signIn: Owner's Shopify account in Chrome
tools.limits: Deploys are manual and need owner approval; a GitHub push alone does not update the live site.

tools.name: merrivy.com (live site)
tools.purpose: Production Merrivy storefront (merrivy.com/products/<handle>) with 1-Product Brand Illusion per product packet, 2-Kit selector, and .99 Shipping Protection.
tools.signIn: No sign-in, public
tools.limits: Deploys to Shopify Oxygen wait for owner approval.

tools.name: GitHub storefront repo
tools.purpose: Private source code for the Hydrogen storefront.
tools.signIn: Owner's GitHub account in Chrome
tools.limits: Commit, push and redeploy wait for owner approval; only the storefront source belongs here, never research, keys or the OS.

tools.name: Meta Ads Manager (Cha Yang account)
tools.purpose: Where ads for Merrivy will run and be read: ad account 9818342388208988 in portfolio Bm ads 223.
tools.signIn: Owner's Facebook login in Chrome; check the account picker shows Cha Yang under Bm ads 223
tools.limits: Link built from the recorded ad account ID: check it opens the right account on first use. Shared with the owner's brother, so leave his campaigns alone; no campaign, budget or spend without approval.

tools.name: Meta connection in Shopify
tools.purpose: Facebook and Instagram app in Shopify admin where catalog, pixel and data sharing get connected.
tools.signIn: Owner's Shopify and Facebook logins in Chrome
tools.limits: Not connected yet; terms, new assets and data-sharing choices need owner approval, and do not reuse the brother's pixels or catalogs.

tools.name: Meta Ad Library
tools.purpose: Find products stable or rising on Meta (Find filter F1-F5: advertisers, longest active ad, live ads), then check the opening at Validate.
tools.signIn: No sign-in needed, public library
tools.limits: Shows ads, not sales or profit. Ad age alone is a weak signal: count different stores and live ads. Free and public; no login.

tools.name: TikTok (original posts)
tools.purpose: Open original creator posts, comments and Shop listings to verify real demonstrations and buyer talk.
tools.signIn: No sign-in needed for public posts
tools.limits: Official homepage, not a recorded working link. Pages can say unavailable in country or show a security check; do not solve CAPTCHAs, and record the gap as unverified.

tools.name: Reddit and buyer forums
tools.purpose: Read real discussions to find who needs a product and in what situation.
tools.signIn: No sign-in needed for public threads
tools.limits: Official homepage, not a recorded working link. Reddit is one source among hobby, owner and support forums; save quotes with links, and some forums return 403.

tools.name: Zoho Mail (support inbox)
tools.purpose: The support@merrivy.com mailbox for customer questions and Shopify sender verification.
tools.signIn: Owner signs in once in Chrome (Mail Free plan, sender Merrivy Support)
tools.limits: Do not send or reply to anyone without owner approval, and keep passwords and message contents out of records.

tools.name: OpenRouter (video generation)
tools.purpose: Paid image-to-video service for short store and ad clips through our generate-video script.
tools.signIn: Owner adds the API key to their Windows environment themselves; never paste it in chat
tools.limits: Paid and not set up yet: dry run by default, and any run needs owner approval, --confirm and --max-cost.

tools.name: Gemini Deep Research
tools.purpose: Wide research with Deep Research: issue research first (Step 1a), then product and avatar questions; agents verify every quote.
tools.signIn: The owner's Gemini Pro is signed in in the shared built-in browser; agents work in that session.
tools.limits: Model 3.8 Flash, never 3.1 Pro. One run at a time. A report is a lead list: verify every quote and link before using it. Upload terms (Agree) are the owner's.

tools.name: EchoTik
tools.purpose: TikTok Shop sales numbers: top products, units sold and sales trend in the US, to prove a product sells (Step 2 statistics).
tools.signIn: Owner signed in once in the built-in browser (Oct 2); agents use that session, never sign in themselves
tools.limits: Estimated from public TikTok Shop signals (a cross-check, not proof on its own). Free plan about 50 searches a day.

tools.name: Amazon (read-only reviews)
tools.purpose: Read full product reviews (2-3 star filters), ratings, Q&A and 'bought in past month' badges for the Buyers step: avatars, pain points, copy. A cross-check for product demand, never proof alone.
tools.signIn: The owner signs in once in the built-in browser (spare account, no card saved); agents use that session
tools.limits: READ-ONLY. Never add to cart, buy, use 1-Click, post reviews or questions, or change any account setting (owner, Oct 3: 'please do not do any cart buys'). Read at a human pace, a handful of products at a time.

tools.name: Google Flow (Image & Veo 3.1 Video Studio)
tools.purpose: Primary engine for ALL store gallery images (#/build), 4:5 DR static ads (#/create & #/assets), and Day 4+ custom 9:16 Veo 3.1 video ads — combining real product truth photos with one static_01..50.png reference layout.
tools.signIn: Owner's Google account signed in inside Chrome (unlimited generation, zero Antigravity credit drain)
tools.limits: Always open a Flow tab in Chrome (via browser-use / CDP 9222 or Chrome MCP) for image and video generation; NEVER use Antigravity's built-in image-generator tool.

tools.name: HyperSKU
tools.purpose: Primary 1-piece dropship sourcing check alongside CJ & Alibaba/AliExpress: verify exact SKU match, weight <1 kg, 7–12d air-shipped DDP cost (<35% of retail), and >= – break-even CPA floor.
tools.signIn: Owner's Chrome session
tools.limits: Read-only during verification; never place orders or message suppliers without owner approval.

tools.name: Google Drive Shared Workspace (gdrive:merrivy)
tools.purpose: Shared 30 TB Google Drive folder for owner and brother: syncs Launchroom state, research, products, creatives, storefront packets, skills, and subagents (`node scripts/sync_gdrive.mjs push|pull`).
tools.signIn: Authenticated via rclone (`gdrive:merrivy`) and owner's Google account in Chrome
tools.limits: Excludes .env secrets, node_modules, and build caches (.rclone-filter.txt). Run `node scripts/sync_gdrive.mjs pull` before starting on another PC and `push` after finishing.
